# Study objectives and design

How the study was set up, who took part, and how the data were analysed.

## Objectives

The primary objective was to characterise the dermatologic tolerability of the treatment over 24 weeks [@doe2020].

{{< lipsum 1 >}}

## Overall design

The study was a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel-group study conducted at multiple sites.
